sentences.en: Gulliver was a man from England.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o était:v un:o homme:n d':o Angleterre:o .:o

sentences.en: He went to sea on great ships, for he wanted to see far lands.
sentences.tgt: Il:o alla:v en:o mer:n sur:o de:o grands:a navires:n ,:o car:o il:o voulait:v voir:v des:o terres:n lointaines:a .:o

sentences.en: His ship sailed for many days over the wide sea.
sentences.tgt: Son:o navire:n navigua:v pendant:o de:o nombreux:a jours:n sur:o la:o vaste:a mer:n .:o

sentences.en: A storm came in the night, and the wind drove the ship through the dark.
sentences.tgt: Une:o tempête:n arriva:v dans:o la:o nuit:n ,:o et:o le:o vent:n poussa:v le:o navire:n dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o

sentences.en: Waves came over the ship, and the masts fell.
sentences.tgt: Des:o vagues:n passèrent:v sur:o le:o navire:n ,:o et:o les:o mâts:n tombèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: The ship hit rocks, and the sea came in.
sentences.tgt: Le:o navire:n heurta:v des:o rochers:n ,:o et:o la:o mer:n entra:v .:o

sentences.en: The men could not hold the ship on the water.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n ne:o pouvaient:v pas:o tenir:v le:o navire:n sur:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver and 6 of the men got away in a small boat.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o et:o 6:o des:o hommes:n s':o échappèrent:v dans:o un:o petit:a bateau:n .:o

sentences.en: But a great wave threw the boat over in the dark.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o une:o grande:a vague:n renversa:v le:o bateau:n dans:o l':o obscurité:n .:o

sentences.en: The boat and the other men were gone.
sentences.tgt: Le:o bateau:n et:o les:o autres:a hommes:n avaient:v disparu:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver could not see the land, but he swam on through the waves.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o ne:o voyait:v pas:o la:o terre:n ,:o mais:o il:o nagea:v à:o travers:o les:o vagues:n .:o

sentences.en: He swam and swam, and his arms grew weak.
sentences.tgt: Il:o nagea:v et:o nagea:v ,:o et:o ses:o bras:n devinrent:v faibles:a .:o

sentences.en: His feet found ground under the water.
sentences.tgt: Ses:o pieds:n trouvèrent:v le:o sol:n sous:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: He walked through the shallow sea to a dark shore.
sentences.tgt: Il:o traversa:v la:o mer:n peu:a profonde:a jusqu':o à:o une:o rive:n sombre:a .:o

sentences.en: He saw no houses and no fire on the shore.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o vit:v ni:o maisons:n ni:o feu:n sur:o la:o rive:n .:o

sentences.en: The grass under his feet was soft.
sentences.tgt: L':o herbe:n sous:o ses:o pieds:n était:v douce:a .:o

sentences.en: He lay down on the grass and slept.
sentences.tgt: Il:o s':o allongea:v sur:o l':o herbe:n et:o dormit:v .:o

sentences.en: Day came, and Gulliver woke.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jour:n vint:v ,:o et:o Gulliver:o se:o réveilla:v .:o

sentences.en: He lay on the grass, but he could not move.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v allongé:a sur:o l':o herbe:n ,:o mais:o il:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o bouger:v .:o

sentences.en: His arms, his legs, and his head were tied down.
sentences.tgt: Ses:o bras:n ,:o ses:o jambes:n et:o sa:o tête:n étaient:v attachés:a au:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: More than 600 thin threads held him to the ground.
sentences.tgt: Plus:a de:o 600:o fils:n fins:a le:o retenaient:v au:o sol:n .:o

sentences.en: Small feet walked up his leg.
sentences.tgt: De:o petits:a pieds:n montèrent:v le:o long:n de:o sa:o jambe:n .:o

sentences.en: They came up over his chest, man after man.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o montèrent:v sur:o sa:o poitrine:n ,:o homme:n après:o homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver looked down and saw a man no taller than his hand.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o regarda:v en:o bas:a et:o vit:v un:o homme:n pas:o plus:a grand:a que:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: The little man pointed an arrow at Gulliver's face.
sentences.tgt: Le:o petit:a homme:n pointa:v une:o flèche:n vers:o le:o visage:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: 40 more little men came up and walked over him, from legs to head.
sentences.tgt: 40:o autres:a petits:a hommes:n montèrent:v et:o marchèrent:v sur:o lui:o ,:o des:o jambes:n à:o la:o tête:n .:o

sentences.en: The men ran down to the ground when Gulliver shouted.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n coururent:v vers:o le:o sol:n quand:o Gulliver:o cria:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver pulled, and one arm came free of the threads.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o tira:v ,:o et:o un:o bras:n se:o libéra:v des:o fils:n .:o

sentences.en: 100 arrows, small as needles, came down on his hand.
sentences.tgt: 100:o flèches:n ,:o petites:a comme:o des:o aiguilles:n ,:o tombèrent:v sur:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: The little arrows hurt, but they could not go deep.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petites:a flèches:n faisaient:v mal:a ,:o mais:o elles:o ne:o pouvaient:v pas:o aller:v loin:a .:o

sentences.en: When Gulliver moved his arm, more arrows came down.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o Gulliver:o bougea:v son:o bras:n ,:o d':o autres:a flèches:n tombèrent:v .:o

sentences.en: He lay still on the grass and waited.
sentences.tgt: Il:o resta:v immobile:a sur:o l':o herbe:n et:o attendit:v .:o

sentences.en: A lord of the little men climbed up on Gulliver's chest and spoke.
sentences.tgt: Un:o seigneur:n des:o petits:a hommes:n monta:v sur:o la:o poitrine:n de:o Gulliver:o et:o parla:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver could not understand the words.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o comprendre:v les:o mots:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver put one free hand to his mouth to show he wanted food.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o porta:v une:o main:n libre:a à:o sa:o bouche:n pour:o montrer:v qu':o il:o voulait:v de:o la:o nourriture:n .:o

sentences.en: The little people understood, and they were not afraid of the giant.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petites:a gens:n comprirent:v ,:o et:o ils:o n':o avaient:v pas:o peur:n du:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: Soon the little people brought food to the giant.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a les:o petites:a gens:n apportèrent:v de:o la:o nourriture:n au:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: 100 men carried meat and bread up to Gulliver's mouth.
sentences.tgt: 100:o hommes:n portèrent:v de:o la:o viande:n et:o du:o pain:n jusqu':o à:o la:o bouche:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver ate it all and wanted more.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o mangea:v tout:o et:o voulut:v davantage:a .:o

sentences.en: The people brought him a strange drink, and it was sweet.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n lui:o apportèrent:v une:o boisson:n étrange:a ,:o et:o elle:o était:v douce:a .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver drank and drank, and soon he slept.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o but:v et:o but:v ,:o et:o bientôt:a il:o dormit:v .:o

sentences.en: The little people had put a sleep powder in the sweet drink.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petites:a gens:n avaient:v mis:v une:o poudre:n soporifique:a dans:o la:o boisson:n douce:a .:o

sentences.en: They wanted to take the giant to the great city in his sleep.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o voulaient:v transporter:v le:o géant:n à:o la:o grande:a cité:n pendant:o son:o sommeil:n .:o

sentences.en: The people of the land built a great cart for the giant.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n du:o pays:n construisirent:v une:o grand:a charrette:n pour:o le:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: 900 men with ropes lifted Gulliver up on the cart.
sentences.tgt: 900:o hommes:n avec:o des:o cordes:n soulevèrent:v Gulliver:o sur:o la:o charrette:n .:o

sentences.en: 1500 small horses pulled the cart, and the horses were smaller than a hand.
sentences.tgt: 1500:o petits:a chevaux:n tirèrent:v la:o charrette:n ,:o et:o les:o chevaux:n étaient:v plus:a petits:a qu':o une:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: They pulled the great cart for a night and a day to the city.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o tirèrent:v la:o grande:a charrette:n pendant:o une:o nuit:n et:o un:o jour:n jusqu':o à:o la:o ville:n .:o

sentences.en: In the city was an old temple, and no house in the land was as great.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o ville:n se:o trouvait:v un:o vieux:a temple:n ,:o et:o aucune:o maison:n du:o pays:n n':o était:v aussi:a grande:a .:o

sentences.en: The people put 91 small chains on one of Gulliver's legs, and the chains held him.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n mirent:v 91:o petites:a chaînes:n sur:o une:o des:o jambes:n de:o Gulliver:o ,:o et:o les:o chaînes:n le:o retinrent:v .:o

sentences.en: When Gulliver woke, he could stand up and walk, but not far.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o Gulliver:o se:o réveilla:v ,:o il:o pouvait:v se:o lever:v et:o marcher:v ,:o mais:o pas:o loin:a .:o

sentences.en: People came from all the land to look at the giant in the chains.
sentences.tgt: Des:o gens:n vinrent:v de:o tout:o le:o pays:n pour:o regarder:v le:o géant:n dans:o les:o chaînes:n .:o

sentences.en: At night, Gulliver lay down in the old temple and slept.
sentences.tgt: La:o nuit:n ,:o Gulliver:o s':o allongea:v dans:o le:o vieux:a temple:n et:o dormit:v .:o

sentences.en: The king of the land came to see the giant.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n du:o pays:n vint:v voir:v le:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: The land was called Lilliput.
sentences.tgt: Le:o pays:n s':o appelait:v Lilliput:o .:o

sentences.en: The king stood a little taller than his lords.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n était:v un:o peu:a plus:a grand:a que:o ses:o seigneurs:n .:o

sentences.en: He looked at the giant's face, at his hands, and at his feet.
sentences.tgt: Il:o regarda:v le:o visage:n du:o géant:n ,:o ses:o mains:n ,:o et:o ses:o pieds:n .:o

sentences.en: The king told the farmers of the land to bring the giant food for 1000 men.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n dit:v aux:o fermiers:n du:o pays:n d':o apporter:v de:o la:o nourriture:n au:o géant:n pour:o 1000:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: Each day, 40 carts of meat and bread came to the temple, and Gulliver ate it all.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o jour:n ,:o 40:o chariots:n de:o viande:n et:o de:o pain:n vinrent:v au:o temple:n ,:o et:o Gulliver:o mangea:v tout:o .:o

sentences.en: In 30 days, Gulliver learned to speak the words of Lilliput.
sentences.tgt: En:o 30:o jours:n ,:o Gulliver:o apprit:v à:o parler:v les:o mots:n de:o Lilliput:o .:o

sentences.en: Little people climbed up Gulliver's arm and stood on his hand.
sentences.tgt: De:o petites:a gens:n grimpèrent:v sur:o le:o bras:n de:o Gulliver:o et:o se:o tinrent:v sur:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: "Set me free," Gulliver asked the king one day.
sentences.tgt: «:o Libérez:v -moi:o ,:o »:o demanda:v Gulliver:o au:o roi:n un:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: The king said that two lords must first look in Gulliver's pockets.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n dit:v que:o deux:o seigneurs:n devaient:v d':o abord:a regarder:v dans:o les:o poches:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver lifted the two lords up in one hand to his pockets.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o souleva:v les:o deux:o seigneurs:n dans:o une:o main:n jusqu'à:o ses:o poches:n .:o

sentences.en: The lords found a knife and gold coins.
sentences.tgt: Les:o seigneurs:n trouvèrent:v un:o couteau:n et:o des:o pièces:n d':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: In one more pocket, the lords found Gulliver's watch.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o une:o autre:a poche:n ,:o les:o seigneurs:n trouvèrent:v la:o montre:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: The watch made a small noise over and over.
sentences.tgt: La:o montre:n faisait:v un:o petit:a bruit:n encore:a et:o encore:a .:o

sentences.en: The lords stood on Gulliver's hand to look at the watch.
sentences.tgt: Les:o seigneurs:n se:o tinrent:v sur:o la:o main:n de:o Gulliver:o pour:o regarder:v la:o montre:n .:o

sentences.en: They thought the watch was the god of the giant.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o pensèrent:v que:o la:o montre:n était:v le:o dieu:n du:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: The king let Gulliver have it all.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n laissa:v Gulliver:o avoir:v tout:o cela:o .:o

sentences.en: The king said Gulliver could be free after one more promise.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n dit:v que:o Gulliver:o pourrait:v être:v libre:a après:o une:o promesse:n de:o plus:o .:o

sentences.chapter: The Promise and the Egg War
sentences.en: The king came again to the temple with his men.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n vint:v de:o nouveau:a au:o temple:n avec:o ses:o hommes:n .:o

sentences.en: "I will walk with care in your city," said Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o marcherai:v avec:o soin:n dans:o votre:o ville:n ,:o »:o dit:v Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: "And I will help the land of Lilliput in war," he said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Et:o j':o aiderai:v la:o terre:n de:o Lilliput:o en:o guerre:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o .:o

sentences.en: The king's men took the 91 chains from Gulliver's leg.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n du:o roi:n prirent:v les:o 91:o chaînes:n de:o la:o jambe:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: He walked with great care over the little city.
sentences.tgt: Il:o marcha:v avec:o grand:a soin:n au-dessus:o de:o la:o petite:a ville:n .:o

sentences.en: He went over the city wall, for the wall was smaller than his leg.
sentences.tgt: Il:o passa:v par-dessus:o le:o mur:n de:o la:o ville:n ,:o car:o le:o mur:n était:v plus:o petit:a que:o sa:o jambe:n .:o

sentences.en: Across the sea lay one more land, Blefuscu.
sentences.tgt: De:o l':o autre:a côté:n de:o la:o mer:n se:o trouvait:v une:o autre:a terre:n ,:o Blefuscu:o .:o

sentences.en: From the wall, Gulliver could see the ships of Blefuscu on the sea.
sentences.tgt: Du:o mur:n ,:o Gulliver:o pouvait:v voir:v les:o navires:n de:o Blefuscu:o sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: The two little lands were enemies.
sentences.tgt: Les:o deux:o petits:a pays:n étaient:v ennemis:a .:o

sentences.en: Lilliput and Blefuscu had fought for years over which end of an egg to break first.
sentences.tgt: Lilliput:o et:o Blefuscu:o s':o étaient:v battus:v pendant:o des:o années:n sur:o quel:o bout:n d':o un:o œuf:n casser:v en:o premier:a .:o

sentences.en: "The ships of Blefuscu will soon come over the sea," the king said to Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o navires:n de:o Blefuscu:o viendront:v bientôt:a sur:o la:o mer:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n à:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: "50 great ships of war lie on the sea at Blefuscu."
sentences.tgt: «:o 50:o grands:a navires:n de:o guerre:n se:o trouvent:v sur:o la:o mer:n à:o Blefuscu:o .:o »:o

sentences.en: "Will you help Lilliput, as you promised?" asked the king.
sentences.tgt: «:o Voulez-vous:v aider:v Lilliput:o ,:o comme:o vous:o l':o avez:v promis:v ?:o »:o demanda:v le:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver carried the king to the sea in his hand.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o porta:v le:o roi:n jusqu':o à:o la:o mer:n dans:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: The sea between the two lands was not deep for a giant.
sentences.tgt: La:o mer:n entre:o les:o deux:o pays:n n':o était:v pas:o profonde:a pour:o un:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: "I will bring you the ships of Blefuscu," said Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o vais:v vous:o apporter:v les:o navires:n de:o Blefuscu:o ,:o »:o dit:v Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: The men of Lilliput brought iron, and Gulliver made 50 great hooks.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n de:o Lilliput:o apportèrent:v du:o fer:n ,:o et:o Gulliver:o fabriqua:v 50:o grands:a crochets:n .:o

sentences.en: He tied one of the 50 ropes to each hook.
sentences.tgt: Il:o attacha:v une:o des:o 50:o cordes:n à:o chaque:o crochet:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver walked into the sea between the two lands.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o marcha:v dans:o la:o mer:n entre:o les:o deux:o terres:n .:o

sentences.en: In the deep water, the sea came up over his chest.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o l':o eau:n profonde:a ,:o la:o mer:n monta:v jusqu':o à:o sa:o poitrine:n .:o

sentences.en: He held the hooks and ropes over the water.
sentences.tgt: Il:o tint:v les:o crochets:n et:o les:o cordes:n au-dessus:o de:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: The men of Blefuscu saw the giant come through the sea.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n de:o Blefuscu:o virent:v le:o géant:n traverser:v la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: They jumped from their ships into the sea and swam to the shore.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o sautèrent:v de:o leurs:o navires:n dans:o la:o mer:n et:o nagèrent:v vers:o le:o rivage:n .:o

sentences.en: 1000 arrows came down on Gulliver's hands and face.
sentences.tgt: 1000:o flèches:n tombèrent:v sur:o les:o mains:n et:o le:o visage:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: The little arrows hurt, but Gulliver walked on.
sentences.tgt: Les:o petites:a flèches:n faisaient:v mal:a ,:o mais:o Gulliver:o continua:v à:o marcher:v .:o

sentences.en: At the ships of Blefuscu, he put one hook on each ship.
sentences.tgt: Près:o des:o navires:n de:o Blefuscu:o ,:o il:o posa:v un:o crochet:n sur:o chaque:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: But the ships did not move, for the anchors held.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o les:o navires:n ne:o bougèrent:v pas:o ,:o car:o les:o ancres:n tenaient:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver took his knife and cut the anchor ropes one by one.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o prit:v son:o couteau:n et:o coupa:v les:o cordes:n d':o ancre:n une:o par:o une:o .:o

sentences.en: He held the ends of all 50 ropes in one hand.
sentences.tgt: Il:o tint:v les:o extrémités:n de:o toutes:o les:o 50:o cordes:n dans:o une:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver turned and pulled the 50 ships after him through the sea.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o se:o retourna:v et:o tira:v les:o 50:o navires:n derrière:o lui:o à:o travers:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: The king of Lilliput stood on his shore and watched the ships come.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n de:o Lilliput:o se:o tint:v sur:o son:o rivage:n et:o regarda:v les:o navires:n arriver:v .:o

sentences.en: "One man took all the ships of Blefuscu!" said the king.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o homme:n a:v pris:v tous:o les:o navires:n de:o Blefuscu:o !:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n .:o

sentences.en: He made Gulliver the first lord of Lilliput that day.
sentences.tgt: Il:o fit:v de:o Gulliver:o le:o premier:a seigneur:n de:o Lilliput:o ce:o jour-là:o .:o

sentences.en: The king of Blefuscu sent men over the sea to ask for peace.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n de:o Blefuscu:o envoya:v des:o hommes:n par:o la:o mer:n pour:o demander:v la:o paix:n .:o

sentences.en: Lilliput and Blefuscu made peace, and the war of the eggs was over.
sentences.tgt: Lilliput:o et:o Blefuscu:o firent:v la:o paix:n ,:o et:o la:o guerre:n des:o œufs:n était:v terminée:a .:o

sentences.en: But the king of Lilliput wanted more than peace.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o roi:n de:o Lilliput:o voulait:v plus:a que:o la:o paix:n .:o

sentences.en: "Take all of Blefuscu for me," the king said to Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: «:o Prenez:v tout:o Blefuscu:o pour:o moi:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n à:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: "Their land will be my land, and their people will be my people."
sentences.tgt: «:o Leur:o terre:n sera:v ma:o terre:n ,:o et:o leur:o peuple:n sera:v mon:o peuple:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: Gulliver looked down at the little king.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o regarda:v en:o bas:a le:o petit:a roi:n .:o

sentences.en: "No," said Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: «:o Non:o ,:o »:o dit:v Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: "The people of Blefuscu are a free people, and I will not take their land."
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o gens:n de:o Blefuscu:o sont:v un:o peuple:n libre:a ,:o et:o je:o ne:o prendrai:v pas:o leur:o terre:n .:o »:o

sentences.en: The king said no more, but from that day he did not laugh with Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n ne:o dit:v plus:o rien:o ,:o mais:o à:o partir:v de:o ce:o jour:n il:o ne:o rit:v plus:o avec:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: One night, the people of the city came calling to the temple.
sentences.tgt: Une:o nuit:n ,:o les:o gens:n de:o la:o ville:n vinrent:v appeler:v au:o temple:n .:o

sentences.en: "Fire, fire!" the people called.
sentences.tgt: «:o Feu:n ,:o feu:n !:o »:o crièrent:v les:o gens:n .:o

sentences.en: "The queen's rooms are on fire!"
sentences.tgt: «:o Les:o chambres:n de:o la:o reine:n sont:v en:o feu:n !:o »:o

sentences.en: Gulliver ran to the palace with great care for the little houses.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o courut:v au:o palais:n avec:o grand:a soin:n pour:o les:o petites:a maisons:n .:o

sentences.en: The people threw little buckets of water on the fire, but the fire grew.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n jetèrent:v de:o petits:a seaux:n d':o eau:n sur:o le:o feu:n ,:o mais:o le:o feu:n grandit:v .:o

sentences.en: The sea was not far, and Gulliver had his great hat.
sentences.tgt: La:o mer:n n':o était:v pas:o loin:a ,:o et:o Gulliver:o avait:v son:o grand:a chapeau:n .:o

sentences.en: He filled the hat with sea water and threw the water on the fire.
sentences.tgt: Il:o remplit:v le:o chapeau:n d':o eau:n de:o mer:n et:o jeta:v l':o eau:n sur:o le:o feu:n .:o

sentences.en: He went to the sea and came back, again and again.
sentences.tgt: Il:o alla:v à:o la:o mer:n et:o revint:v ,:o encore:a et:o encore:a .:o

sentences.en: Soon the fire was out, and the palace still stood.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a le:o feu:n fut:v éteint:a ,:o et:o le:o palais:n tenait:v encore:a debout:a .:o

sentences.en: But sea water lay over all the rooms of the queen.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o l':o eau:n de:o mer:n couvrait:v toutes:o les:o chambres:n de:o la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: The queen did not laugh with Gulliver again.
sentences.tgt: La:o reine:n ne:o rit:v plus:o avec:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: After the fire, some lords of the court wanted the giant gone.
sentences.tgt: Après:o l':o incendie:n ,:o certains:o seigneurs:n de:o la:o cour:n voulaient:v le:o géant:n parti:a .:o

sentences.en: "The giant eats the food of 1000 men," said one lord.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o géant:n mange:v la:o nourriture:n de:o 1000:o hommes:n ,:o »:o dit:v un:o seigneur:n .:o

sentences.en: "He would not take Blefuscu for his king," said the queen.
sentences.tgt: «:o Il:o ne:o prendrait:v pas:o Blefuscu:o pour:o son:o roi:n ,:o »:o dit:v la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: The court said the giant must be tied down again, for all his days.
sentences.tgt: La:o cour:n dit:v que:o le:o géant:n devait:v être:v attaché:a de:o nouveau:a ,:o pour:o tous:o ses:o jours:n .:o

sentences.en: But one lord of the court was Gulliver's friend.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o un:o seigneur:n de:o la:o cour:n était:v l':o ami:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: That night, the friend came alone in the dark to the temple.
sentences.tgt: Cette:o nuit-là:o ,:o l':o ami:n vint:v seul:a dans:o l':o obscurité:n jusqu':o au:o temple:n .:o

sentences.en: The giant put the friend up on his hand.
sentences.tgt: Le:o géant:n posa:v l':o ami:n sur:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: "The court will put you in chains again," said the friend.
sentences.tgt: «:o La:o cour:n va:v vous:o mettre:v ·:o de:o nouveau:a dans:o les:o chaînes:n ,:o »:o dit:v l':o ami:n .:o

sentences.en: "Go from Lilliput this night."
sentences.tgt: Pars:v de:o Lilliput:o cette:o nuit:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver did not want a war with the little people of the land.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o ne:o voulait:v pas:o la:o guerre:n avec:o les:o petits:a peuples:n du:o pays:n .:o

sentences.en: He thanked the friend and put him down on the ground.
sentences.tgt: Il:o remercia:v l':o ami:n et:o le:o posa:v par:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: In the dark, Gulliver walked into the sea and went over to Blefuscu.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o l':o obscurité:n ,:o Gulliver:o entra:v dans:o la:o mer:n et:o alla:v vers:o Blefuscu:o .:o

sentences.en: The king of Blefuscu came to the shore with many of his little people.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n de:o Blefuscu:o vint:v au:o rivage:n avec:o beaucoup:a de:o ses:o petits:a peuples:n .:o

sentences.en: He was glad to see the man that had not taken his land.
sentences.tgt: Il:o était:v content:a de:o voir:v l':o homme:n qui:o n':o avait:v pas:o pris:v sa:o terre:n .:o

sentences.en: "You will be safe in Blefuscu," said the king of Blefuscu.
sentences.tgt: «:o Vous:o serez:v en:o sécurité:n à:o Blefuscu:o ,:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n de:o Blefuscu:o .:o

sentences.en: The people of Blefuscu brought the giant food each day.
sentences.tgt: Les:o peuples:n de:o Blefuscu:o apportèrent:v de:o la:o nourriture:n au:o géant:n chaque:o jour:n .:o

sentences.en: But at night, Gulliver looked over the sea and wanted to go home to England.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o la:o nuit:n ,:o Gulliver:o regardait:v la:o mer:n et:o voulait:v rentrer:v chez:o lui:o en:o Angleterre:o .:o

sentences.en: One day, Gulliver saw a real boat far out on the sea.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o Gulliver:o vit:v un:o vrai:a bateau:n loin:a sur:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: It was a boat from a great ship, and the sea had turned it over.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o bateau:n d':o un:o grand:a navire:n ,:o et:o la:o mer:n l':o avait:v retourné:v .:o

sentences.en: The wind drove the boat into the shallow water, and Gulliver swam out to it.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vent:n poussa:v le:o bateau:n vers:o les:o eaux:n peu:a profondes:a ,:o et:o Gulliver:o nagea:v jusqu':o à:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: With 2000 men of Blefuscu and many ropes, he turned the boat over in the water.
sentences.tgt: Avec:o 2000:o hommes:n de:o Blefuscu:o et:o beaucoup:a de:o cordes:n ,:o il:o retourna:v le:o bateau:n dans:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: The king of Blefuscu gave Gulliver wood, and soon the boat was good again.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n de:o Blefuscu:o donna:v à:o Gulliver:o du:o bois:n ,:o et:o bientôt:a le:o bateau:n était:v de:o nouveau:a .:o

sentences.en: The people of Blefuscu brought meat, bread, and milk for the long way home.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n de:o Blefuscu:o apportèrent:v de:o la:o viande:n ,:o du:o pain:n ,:o et:o du:o lait:n pour:o le:o long:a chemin:n du:o retour:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver took 6 little cows of Blefuscu into the boat too.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o prit:v aussi:a 6:o petites:a vaches:n de:o Blefuscu:o dans:o le:o bateau:n .:o

sentences.en: He wanted to show England the little cows.
sentences.tgt: Il:o voulait:v montrer:v à:o l':o Angleterre:o les:o petites:a vaches:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver thanked the king of Blefuscu and sailed away.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o remercia:v le:o roi:n de:o Blefuscu:o et:o navigua:v au:o loin:a .:o

sentences.en: After two days on the sea, Gulliver saw a great ship.
sentences.tgt: Après:o deux:o jours:n sur:o la:o mer:n ,:o Gulliver:o vit:v un:o grand:a navire:n .:o

sentences.en: It was a ship from England, with men as great as Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: C':o était:v un:o navire:n d':o Angleterre:o ,:o avec:o des:o hommes:n aussi:a grands:a que:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: The men of the ship took Gulliver and his boat up from the sea.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n du:o navire:n prirent:v Gulliver:o et:o son:o bateau:n hors:o de:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver told the captain of Lilliput, and the captain laughed.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o parla:v au:o capitaine:n de:o Lilliput:o ,:o et:o le:o capitaine:n rit:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver went to his boat and took out one little cow.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o alla:v à:o son:o bateau:n et:o en:o sortit:v une:o petite:a vache:n .:o

sentences.en: He put the little cow in the captain's hand.
sentences.tgt: Il:o posa:v la:o petite:a vache:n dans:o la:o main:n du:o capitaine:n .:o

sentences.en: The captain looked at it and laughed no more.
sentences.tgt: Le:o capitaine:n le:o regarda:v et:o ne:o rit:v plus:o .:o

sentences.en: The ship sailed home, and Gulliver came to his house in England.
sentences.tgt: Le:o navire:n rentra:v chez:o lui:o ,:o et:o Gulliver:o arriva:v à:o sa:o maison:n en:o Angleterre:o .:o

sentences.en: His wife had thought the sea had taken him, and she laughed and cried to see him.
sentences.tgt: Sa:o femme:n avait:v cru:v que:o la:o mer:n l':o avait:v emporté:v ,:o et:o elle:o rit:v et:o pleura:v de:o joie:n en:o le:o voyant:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver stayed at home for 60 days.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o resta:v chez:o lui:o pendant:o 60:o jours:n .:o

sentences.en: But he still thought of the sea and far lands.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o il:o pensait:v encore:a à:o la:o mer:n et:o aux:o terres:n lointaines:a .:o

sentences.en: When the 60 days were over, a new ship sailed from England.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o les:o 60:o jours:n furent:v passés:a ,:o un:o nouveau:a navire:n quitta:v l':o Angleterre:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver went with it, for he still wanted to see far lands.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o l':o accompagna:v ,:o car:o il:o voulait:v encore:a voir:v des:o terres:n lointaines:a .:o

sentences.en: Far out on the sea, a great storm drove the ship for many days.
sentences.tgt: Loin:a sur:o la:o mer:n ,:o une:o grande:a tempête:n poussa:v le:o navire:n pendant:o de:o nombreux:a jours:n .:o

sentences.en: No man on the ship knew the way home.
sentences.tgt: Aucun:o homme:n sur:o le:o navire:n ne:o connaissait:v le:o chemin:n du:o retour:n .:o

sentences.en: When the storm was over, the men saw a strange land.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o la:o tempête:n fut:v passée:a ,:o les:o hommes:n aperçurent:v une:o terre:n étrange:a .:o

sentences.en: The men wanted water, so the captain sent a boat to the shore.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n voulaient:v de:o l':o eau:n ,:o alors:o le:o capitaine:n envoya:v un:o bateau:n vers:o le:o rivage:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver went with the boat and walked alone over the strange land.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o monta:v dans:o le:o bateau:n et:o marcha:v seul:a sur:o cette:o terre:n étrange:a .:o

sentences.en: He walked a mile from the shore and saw no man and no house.
sentences.tgt: Il:o marcha:v à:o un:o mile:n du:o rivage:n et:o ne:o vit:v ni:o homme:n ni:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: When Gulliver came back, the boat was far out on the water.
sentences.tgt: Quand:o Gulliver:o revint:v ,:o le:o bateau:n était:v loin:a sur:o l':o eau:n .:o

sentences.en: The men in the boat rowed fast for the ship.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n dans:o le:o bateau:n ramèrent:v vite:a vers:o le:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: A giant man walked in the sea after the boat.
sentences.tgt: Un:o homme:n géant:a marcha:v dans:o la:o mer:n après:o le:o bateau:n .:o

sentences.en: The sea came only to the giant's knees.
sentences.tgt: La:o mer:n arrivait:v seulement:a aux:o genoux:n du:o géant:n .:o

sentences.en: The giant was as tall as a ship's mast.
sentences.tgt: Le:o géant:n était:v aussi:a grand:a que:o le:o mât:n d':o un:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver called from the shore, but the boat did not come back.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o appela:v depuis:o le:o rivage:n ,:o mais:o le:o bateau:n ne:o revint:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: He ran from the sea into the land.
sentences.tgt: Il:o courut:v de:o la:o mer:n vers:o l':o intérieur:n des:o terres:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver came to a great field of yellow grain.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o arriva:v à:o un:o grand:a champ:n de:o grain:n jaune:a .:o

sentences.en: The grain stood far over his head, as tall as the trees of England.
sentences.tgt: Le:o grain:n s':o élevait:v bien:a au-dessus:o de:o sa:o tête:n ,:o aussi:a grand:a que:o les:o arbres:n d':o Angleterre:o .:o

sentences.en: He heard great feet come through the grain, and he hid and waited.
sentences.tgt: Il:o entendit:v de:o grands:a pas:n traverser:v le:o grain:n ,:o et:o il:o se:o cacha:v et:o attendit:v .:o

sentences.en: Giant men came through the field and cut down the tall grain.
sentences.tgt: Des:o hommes:n géants:a traversèrent:v le:o champ:n et:o coupèrent:v le:o grand:a grain:n .:o

sentences.en: Great feet came down in the tall grain by Gulliver's head.
sentences.tgt: De:o grands:a pieds:n s':o abattirent:v sur:o le:o grand:a grain:n près:o de:o la:o tête:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver called and called up at the giant men.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o appela:v et:o appela:v encore:a les:o hommes:n géants:a .:o

sentences.en: The great feet stood still in the grain.
sentences.tgt: Les:o grands:a pieds:n s':o immobilisèrent:v dans:o le:o grain:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer of the field looked down and saw the little man in the grain.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n du:o champ:n regarda:v en:o bas:a et:o vit:v le:o petit:a homme:n dans:o le:o grain:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer took Gulliver up between his finger and his thumb.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n prit:v Gulliver:o entre:o son:o doigt:n et:o son:o pouce:n .:o

sentences.en: He lifted the little man high over the field to look at him.
sentences.tgt: Il:o souleva:v le:o petit:a homme:n haut:a au-dessus:o du:o champ:n pour:o le:o regarder:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver held the great thumb, for the ground was far down.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o tint:v le:o grand:a pouce:n ,:o car:o le:o sol:n était:v loin:a en:o bas:a .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver bowed in the great hand and spoke, but the farmer could not understand the little words.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o s':o inclina:v dans:o la:o grande:a main:n et:o parla:v ,:o mais:o le:o fermier:n ne:o pouvait:v pas:o comprendre:v les:o petits:a mots:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer put Gulliver in his pocket and carried him home.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n mit:v Gulliver:o dans:o sa:o poche:n et:o le:o porta:v chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: At the house, the farmer took Gulliver from the pocket and put him on the table.
sentences.tgt: À:o la:o maison:n ,:o le:o fermier:n sortit:v Gulliver:o de:o la:o poche:n et:o le:o posa:v sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer's wife saw the little man, and her cup fell from her hand.
sentences.tgt: La:o femme:n du:o fermier:n vit:v le:o petit:a homme:n ,:o et:o sa:o tasse:n tomba:v de:o sa:o main:n .:o

sentences.en: But Gulliver bowed to her too, and soon she laughed.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o Gulliver:o s':o inclina:v devant:o elle:o aussi:a ,:o et:o bientôt:a elle:o rit:v .:o

sentences.en: The farmer and his wife sat down at the table with bread and milk.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n et:o sa:o femme:n s':o assirent:v à:o la:o table:n avec:o du:o pain:n et:o du:o lait:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver drank milk from the smallest cup of the house, and the cup was as great as a bucket.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o but:v du:o lait:n dans:o la:o plus:o petite:a tasse:n de:o la:o maison:n ,:o et:o la:o tasse:n était:v aussi:o grande:a qu':o un:o seau:n .:o

sentences.en: He fell over the bread on the table, and the giants laughed.
sentences.tgt: Il:o trébucha:v sur:o le:o pain:n sur:o la:o table:n ,:o et:o les:o géants:n rirent:v .:o

sentences.en: The farmer's daughter watched the little man with care.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n du:o fermier:n observa:v le:o petit:a homme:n avec:o soin:n .:o

sentences.en: That night, the daughter put soft cloth in a small box for Gulliver's bed.
sentences.tgt: Ce:o soir-là:a ,:o la:o fille:n mit:v du:o tissu:n doux:a dans:o une:o petite:a boîte:n pour:o le:o lit:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: In the box bed, Gulliver slept his first night in the land of the giants.
sentences.tgt: Dans:o la:o boîte:n ,:o Gulliver:o dormit:v sa:o première:a nuit:n dans:o le:o pays:n des:o géants:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer's daughter took care of Gulliver in the great house.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n du:o fermier:n prit:v soin:n de:o Gulliver:o dans:o la:o grande:a maison:n .:o

sentences.en: She made him new clothes from soft cloth.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o lui:o fit:v de:o nouveaux:a vêtements:n en:o tissu:n doux:a .:o

sentences.en: She set his food by his box bed and kept him safe.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o posa:v sa:o nourriture:n près:o de:o sa:o boîte:n et:o le:o garda:v en:o sécurité:n .:o

sentences.en: Each day, the daughter gave Gulliver more words of the land.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o jour:n ,:o la:o fille:n donna:v à:o Gulliver:o plus:o de:o mots:n du:o pays:n .:o

sentences.en: She pointed at the bread, the milk, the cup, and the fire, and said each word.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o pointa:v le:o pain:n ,:o le:o lait:n ,:o la:o tasse:n ,:o et:o le:o feu:n ,:o et:o dit:v chaque:o mot:n .:o

sentences.en: He learned fast, for he had learned the words of Lilliput too.
sentences.tgt: Il:o apprit:v vite:a ,:o car:o il:o avait:v appris:v les:o mots:n de:o Lilliput:o aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: Soon the little man could speak with the daughter.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a le:o petit:a homme:n put:v parler:v avec:o la:o fille:n .:o

sentences.en: "This land is Brobdingnag," said the daughter.
sentences.tgt: «:o Cette:o terre:n est:v Brobdingnag:o ,:o »:o dit:v la:o fille:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver told the daughter of England and of little Lilliput.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o parla:v à:o la:o fille:n de:o l':o Angleterre:n et:o du:o petit:a Lilliput:o .:o

sentences.en: One day, an old farmer came to the house to see the little man.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o un:o vieux:a fermier:n vint:v à:o la:o maison:n pour:o voir:v le:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver walked on the table, bowed, and spoke to him.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o marcha:v sur:o la:o table:n ,:o s':o inclina:v ,:o et:o lui:o parla:v .:o

sentences.en: The old farmer looked and looked at the little man.
sentences.tgt: Le:o vieux:a fermier:n regarda:v et:o regarda:v le:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "Show the little man at the market for money," the old farmer said.
sentences.tgt: «:o Montrez:v le:o petit:a homme:n au:o marché:n pour:o de:o l':o argent:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o vieux:a fermier:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer of the house heard him and thought of the money.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n de:o la:o maison:n l':o entendit:v et:o pensa:v à:o l':o argent:n .:o

sentences.en: "The little man will go to the market," said the farmer of the house.
sentences.tgt: «:o Le:o petit:a homme:n ira:v au:o marché:n ,:o »:o dit:v le:o fermier:n de:o la:o maison:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter was afraid for Gulliver, so she said she would go too.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n avait:v peur:n pour:o Gulliver:o ,:o alors:o elle:o dit:v qu':o elle:o irait:v aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: The daughter set more soft cloth in Gulliver's box for the market.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n mit:v plus:a de:o tissu:n doux:a dans:o la:o boîte:n de:o Gulliver:o pour:o le:o marché:n .:o

sentences.en: On market day, the farmer rode his horse to the market town.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jour:n du:o marché:n ,:o le:o fermier:n chevaucha:v son:o cheval:n jusqu':o au:o bourg:n du:o marché:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter held Gulliver's box with great care on the way.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n tint:v la:o boîte:n de:o Gulliver:o avec:o grand:a soin:n pendant:o le:o trajet:n .:o

sentences.en: At the market, the farmer set the box on a great table.
sentences.tgt: Au:o marché:n ,:o le:o fermier:n posa:v la:o boîte:n sur:o une:o grande:a table:n .:o

sentences.en: "Come and see the little man from the sea!" called the farmer.
sentences.tgt: «:o Venez:v voir:v le:o petit:a homme:n de:o la:o mer:n !:o »:o cria:v le:o fermier:n .:o

sentences.en: The people of the town paid the farmer silver coins and came in to look.
sentences.tgt: Les:o gens:n de:o la:o ville:n payèrent:v au:o fermier:n des:o pièces:n d':o argent:n et:o entrèrent:v pour:o regarder:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver walked up and down the table and bowed to the crowd.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o fit:v des:o allers-retours:n sur:o la:o table:n et:o s':o inclina:v devant:o la:o foule:n .:o

sentences.en: He spoke the words of the land, and the crowd watched with open mouths.
sentences.tgt: Il:o prononça:v les:o mots:n de:o la:o région:n ,:o et:o la:o foule:n regarda:v avec:o des:o bouches:n ouvertes:a .:o

sentences.en: He drank from a little cup, and the crowd laughed and paid more.
sentences.tgt: Il:o but:v dans:o une:o petite:a coupe:n ,:o et:o la:o foule:n rit:v et:o paya:v davantage:a .:o

sentences.en: The farmer looked at all the silver and laughed.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n regarda:v tout:o l':o argent:n et:o rit:v .:o

sentences.en: After that, the farmer showed Gulliver at market after market.
sentences.tgt: Après:o cela:o ,:o le:o fermier:n montra:v Gulliver:o à:o marché:n après:o marché:n .:o

sentences.en: They went from town to town for many weeks.
sentences.tgt: Ils:o allèrent:v de:o ville:n en:o ville:n pendant:o de:o nombreuses:a semaines:n .:o

sentences.en: He could not rest, and he could not sleep.
sentences.tgt: Il:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o se:o reposer:v ,:o et:o il:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o dormir:v .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver grew thin and tired and weak.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o devint:v mince:a et:o fatigué:a et:o faible:a .:o

sentences.en: In the end, the farmer took Gulliver to the great city of the land.
sentences.tgt: À:o la:o fin:n ,:o le:o fermier:n emmena:v Gulliver:o dans:o la:o grande:a ville:n du:o pays:n .:o

sentences.en: The king and queen of the giants lived there, in a palace of high walls.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n et:o la:o reine:n des:o géants:n vivaient:v là:o ,:o dans:o un:o palais:n aux:o murs:n hauts:a .:o

sentences.en: Soon the queen heard of the little man and called for him to the palace.
sentences.tgt: Bientôt:a la:o reine:n entendit:v parler:v du:o petit:a homme:n et:o le:o fit:v appeler:v au:o palais:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer carried Gulliver's box to the palace of the queen.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n porta:v la:o boîte:n de:o Gulliver:o au:o palais:n de:o la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver walked out of the box and bowed to the queen of the giants.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o sortit:v de:o la:o boîte:n et:o s':o inclina:v devant:o la:o reine:n des:o géants:n .:o

sentences.en: "Will you make your home at my palace?" the queen asked the little man.
sentences.tgt: «:o Voulez-vous:v faire:v votre:o maison:n dans:o mon:o palais:n ?:o »:o demanda:v la:o reine:n au:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: "I will come if the daughter comes too, for she takes care of me," said Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: «:o Je:o viendrai:v si:o la:o fille:n vient:v aussi:a ,:o car:o elle:o s':o occupe:v de:o moi:o »:o ,:o dit:v Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: The queen was glad to let the daughter come.
sentences.tgt: La:o reine:n fut:v heureuse:a de:o laisser:v la:o fille:n venir:v .:o

sentences.en: The queen bought Gulliver from the farmer for 1000 gold coins.
sentences.tgt: La:o reine:n acheta:v Gulliver:o au:o fermier:n pour:o 1000:o pièces:n d':o or:n .:o

sentences.en: The farmer took the gold, laughed, and rode home.
sentences.tgt: Le:o fermier:n prit:v l':o or:n ,:o rit:v ,:o et:o rentra:v chez:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: The queen's men built Gulliver a little room of wood.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n de:o la:o reine:n construisirent:v à:o Gulliver:o une:o petite:a chambre:n de:o bois:n .:o

sentences.en: The little room had a door, two windows, a table, a chair, and a bed.
sentences.tgt: La:o petite:a chambre:n avait:v une:o porte:n ,:o deux:o fenêtres:n ,:o une:o table:n ,:o une:o chaise:n ,:o et:o un:o lit:n .:o

sentences.en: The queen's men put soft cloth on the walls of the room.
sentences.tgt: Les:o hommes:n de:o la:o reine:n posèrent:v du:o tissu:n doux:a sur:o les:o murs:n de:o la:o chambre:n .:o

sentences.en: On the roof of the room, the men put a great iron ring.
sentences.tgt: Sur:o le:o toit:n de:o la:o chambre:n ,:o les:o hommes:n posèrent:v un:o grand:a anneau:n de:o fer:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter took the ring and carried the box from room to room.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n prit:v l':o anneau:n et:o porta:v la:o boîte:n de:o chambre:n en:o chambre:n .:o

sentences.en: One day, the king of the giants came to see the queen's little man.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o le:o roi:n des:o géants:n vint:v voir:v le:o petit:a homme:n de:o la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: The king thought the queen's little man was a toy.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n pensa:v que:o le:o petit:a homme:n de:o la:o reine:n était:v un:o jouet:n .:o

sentences.en: But the toy bowed and asked the king about his great land.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o le:o jouet:n s':o inclina:v et:o demanda:v au:o roi:n à:o propos:o de:o sa:o grande:a terre:n .:o

sentences.en: The king asked Gulliver 100 questions, and Gulliver answered each one.
sentences.tgt: Le:o roi:n posa:v à:o Gulliver:o 100:o questions:n ,:o et:o Gulliver:o répondit:v à:o chacune:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver spoke of the wars of England, and the king laughed and laughed.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o parla:v des:o guerres:n d':o Angleterre:o ,:o et:o le:o roi:n rit:v et:o rit:v .:o

sentences.en: "So small a people, and so great a war!" said the king of the giants.
sentences.tgt: «:o Un:o peuple:n si:a petit:a ,:o et:o une:o si:a grande:a guerre:n !:o »:o dit:v le:o roi:n des:o géants:n .:o

sentences.en: Each day, Gulliver ate dinner at the queen's great table.
sentences.tgt: Chaque:o jour:n ,:o Gulliver:o dînait:v à:o la:o grande:a table:n de:o la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: His little chair and table stood by the queen's great plate.
sentences.tgt: Sa:o petite:a chaise:n et:o sa:o table:n se:o trouvaient:v près:o de:o la:o grande:a assiette:n de:o la:o reine:n .:o

sentences.en: A dwarf lived at the court of the queen too.
sentences.tgt: Un:o nain:n vivait:v à:o la:o cour:n de:o la:o reine:n aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: Before Gulliver came, the dwarf was the smallest man of the court.
sentences.tgt: Avant:o que:o Gulliver:o arrive:v ,:o le:o nain:n était:v le:o plus:o petit:a homme:n de:o la:o cour:n .:o

sentences.en: But the court only watched Gulliver now, and no one watched the dwarf.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o la:o cour:n ne:o regardait:v que:o Gulliver:o maintenant:a ,:o et:o personne:o ne:o regardait:v le:o nain:n .:o

sentences.en: The dwarf was angry at the little man.
sentences.tgt: Le:o nain:n était:v en:o colère:n contre:o le:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: One day at dinner, a great silver bowl of sweet cream stood on the table.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n à:o dîner:n ,:o un:o grand:a bol:n d':o argent:n plein:a de:o crème:n sucrée:a se:o trouvait:v sur:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: The cream in the bowl was deep for a little man.
sentences.tgt: La:o crème:n dans:o le:o bol:n était:v profonde:a pour:o un:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: The dwarf took Gulliver from his chair and dropped him into the cream.
sentences.tgt: Le:o nain:n prit:v Gulliver:o de:o sa:o chaise:n et:o le:o laissa:v tomber:v dans:o la:o crème:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver went down into the deep cream.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o descendit:v dans:o la:o crème:n profonde:a .:o

sentences.en: But Gulliver had swum in the great sea, and he could swim in cream.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o Gulliver:o avait:v nagé:v dans:o la:o grande:a mer:n ,:o et:o il:o pouvait:v nager:v dans:o la:o crème:n .:o

sentences.en: He held his head up and swam in the cream.
sentences.tgt: Il:o maintint:v sa:o tête:n au-dessus:a et:o nagea:v dans:o la:o crème:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter saw him and ran to the table.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n le:o vit:v et:o courut:v à:o la:o table:n .:o

sentences.en: She put her great spoon into the cream, and Gulliver climbed on.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o plongea:v sa:o grande:a cuillère:n dans:o la:o crème:n ,:o et:o Gulliver:o monta:v dessus:a .:o

sentences.en: The daughter lifted Gulliver out and made him dry with soft cloth.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n sortit:v Gulliver:o et:o le:o sécha:v avec:o un:o tissu:n doux:a .:o

sentences.en: The queen was angry at the dwarf.
sentences.tgt: La:o reine:n était:v en:o colère:n contre:o le:o nain:n .:o

sentences.en: She sent the dwarf away from the court that day.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o renvoya:v le:o nain:n de:o la:o cour:n ce:o jour-là:a .:o

sentences.en: But after that, the daughter watched Gulliver with more care at dinner.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o après:o cela:o ,:o la:o fille:n surveilla:v Gulliver:o avec:o plus:o de:o soin:n au:o dîner:n .:o

sentences.en: One warm morning, the queen called the daughter away.
sentences.tgt: Un:o matin:n chaud:a ,:o la:o reine:n appela:v la:o fille:n loin:a .:o

sentences.en: The window of Gulliver's little room stood open to the garden.
sentences.tgt: La:o fenêtre:n de:o la:o petite:a chambre:n de:o Gulliver:o donnait:v ouverte:a sur:o le:o jardin:n .:o

sentences.en: A monkey lived in the trees of the palace garden.
sentences.tgt: Un:o singe:n vivait:v dans:o les:o arbres:n du:o jardin:n du:o palais:n .:o

sentences.en: The monkey came down, ran over the wall, and climbed in at the open window.
sentences.tgt: Le:o singe:n descendit:v ,:o courut:v par-dessus:o le:o mur:n ,:o et:o entra:v par:o la:o fenêtre:n ouverte:a .:o

sentences.en: It found Gulliver in the little room.
sentences.tgt: Il:o trouva:v Gulliver:o dans:o la:o petite:a chambre:n .:o

sentences.en: The monkey took Gulliver up in one arm, as monkeys hold their young.
sentences.tgt: Le:o singe:n prit:v Gulliver:o dans:o un:o bras:n ,:o comme:o les:o singes:n tiennent:v leurs:o petits:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver saw the great teeth and could not get free.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o vit:v les:o grandes:a dents:n et:o ne:o put:v pas:o se:o libérer:v .:o

sentences.en: It put food from its mouth into Gulliver's mouth.
sentences.tgt: Il:o mit:v de:o la:o nourriture:n de:o sa:o bouche:n dans:o la:o bouche:n de:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: The monkey jumped out of the window with Gulliver and climbed up the palace wall.
sentences.tgt: Le:o singe:n sauta:v par:o la:o fenêtre:n avec:o Gulliver:o et:o grimpa:v le:o long:o du:o mur:n du:o palais:n .:o

sentences.en: It ran up and up, to the top of the palace roof.
sentences.tgt: Il:o courut:v de:o plus:o en:o plus:o haut:a ,:o jusqu':o au:o sommet:n du:o toit:n du:o palais:n .:o

sentences.en: The garden lay far below the little man.
sentences.tgt: Le:o jardin:n était:v loin:a en:o dessous:o du:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Great screams came from the garden below.
sentences.tgt: De:o grands:a cris:n vinrent:v du:o jardin:n en:o bas:a .:o

sentences.en: The daughter ran out and called for the little man.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n courut:v dehors:a et:o appela:v le:o petit:a homme:n .:o

sentences.en: Men came with long ladders and climbed to the roof.
sentences.tgt: Des:o hommes:n vinrent:v avec:o de:o longues:a échelles:n et:o montèrent:v sur:o le:o toit:n .:o

sentences.en: The monkey saw the men, set Gulliver down on the roof, and ran away over the wall.
sentences.tgt: Le:o singe:n vit:v les:o hommes:n ,:o posa:v Gulliver:o sur:o le:o toit:n ,:o et:o s':o enfuit:v par-dessus:o le:o mur:n .:o

sentences.en: One of the queen's men put Gulliver in his pocket and climbed down the ladder.
sentences.tgt: Un:o des:o hommes:n de:o la:o reine:n mit:v Gulliver:o dans:o sa:o poche:n et:o descendit:v l':o échelle:n .:o

sentences.en: The daughter held Gulliver, and her great tears fell on him.
sentences.tgt: La:o fille:n tint:v Gulliver:o ,:o et:o ses:o grandes:a larmes:n tombèrent:v sur:o lui:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver was sick for two days from the monkey's food.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o fut:v malade:a pendant:o deux:o jours:n à:o cause:n de:o la:o nourriture:n du:o singe:n .:o

sentences.en: After that day, the window of the little room stood open no more.
sentences.tgt: Après:o ce:o jour:n ,:o la:o fenêtre:n de:o la:o petite:a chambre:n resta:v ouverte:a plus:o jamais:o .:o

sentences.en: One day, the king and queen went down to the sea and took Gulliver too.
sentences.tgt: Un:o jour:n ,:o le:o roi:n et:o la:o reine:n descendirent:v vers:o la:o mer:n et:o emmenèrent:v Gulliver:o aussi:a .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver had not seen the sea for two years, and he wanted to see the waves again.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o n':o avait:v pas:o vu:v la:o mer:n depuis:o deux:o ans:n ,:o et:o il:o voulait:v revoir:v les:o vagues:n .:o

sentences.en: But that day the daughter was sick and could not come down to the shore.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o ce:o jour:n -là:o ,:o la:o fille:n était:v malade:a et:o ne:o pouvait:v pas:o descendre:v au:o rivage:n .:o

sentences.en: A boy carried Gulliver's box down to the rocks by the sea.
sentences.tgt: Un:o garçon:n porta:v la:o boîte:n de:o Gulliver:o jusqu':o aux:o rochers:n au:o bord:n de:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver was tired, and he lay down on the bed in the box.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o était:v fatigué:a ,:o et:o il:o s':o allongea:v sur:o le:o lit:n dans:o la:o boîte:n .:o

sentences.en: The boy set the box on the rocks and walked away to look for birds' eggs.
sentences.tgt: Le:o garçon:n posa:v la:o boîte:n sur:o les:o rochers:n et:o s':o éloigna:v pour:o chercher:v des:o œufs:n d':o oiseaux:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver woke when great wings came down over the box.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o se:o réveilla:v quand:o de:o grandes:a ailes:n descendirent:v sur:o la:o boîte:n .:o

sentences.en: All at once, the box rose fast into the air.
sentences.tgt: Tout:o à:o coup:o ,:o la:o boîte:n monta:v vite:a dans:o l':o air:n .:o

sentences.en: An eagle had taken the box by the great iron ring.
sentences.tgt: Un:o aigle:n avait:v saisi:v la:o boîte:n par:o le:o grand:a anneau:n de:o fer:n .:o

sentences.en: The eagle flew high over the sea with the box.
sentences.tgt: L':o aigle:n vola:v haut:a au-dessus:o de:o la:o mer:n avec:o la:o boîte:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver looked out of the window and saw only air and sea.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o regarda:v par:o la:o fenêtre:n et:o ne:o vit:v que:o de:o l':o air:n et:o de:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: More great wings came, and other birds flew at the eagle.
sentences.tgt: De:o grandes:a ailes:n arrivèrent:v ,:o et:o d':o autres:o oiseaux:n volèrent:v vers:o l':o aigle:n .:o

sentences.en: The eagle let the box go.
sentences.tgt: L':o aigle:n lâcha:v la:o boîte:n .:o

sentences.en: The box fell down and down through the air.
sentences.tgt: La:o boîte:n tomba:v de:o plus:o en:o plus:o bas:a dans:o l':o air:n .:o

sentences.en: It hit the sea and went under, but the box came up again.
sentences.tgt: Elle:o heurta:v la:o mer:n et:o passa:v dessous:o ,:o mais:o la:o boîte:n remonta:v .:o

sentences.en: The box was good dry wood, and it did not sink.
sentences.tgt: La:o boîte:n était:v faite:v de:o bon:a bois:n sec:a ,:o et:o elle:o ne:o coula:v pas:o .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver held fast in the box and was not hurt.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o se:o tint:v fermement:a dans:o la:o boîte:n et:o ne:o fut:v pas:o blessé:a .:o

sentences.en: The waves lifted the box up and down on the great sea.
sentences.tgt: Les:o vagues:n soulevèrent:v la:o boîte:n en:o haut:a et:o en:o bas:a sur:o la:o grande:a mer:n .:o

sentences.en: Men on a great ship of England saw the box on the waves.
sentences.tgt: Des:o hommes:n sur:o un:o grand:a navire:n d':o Angleterre:o virent:v la:o boîte:n sur:o les:o vagues:n .:o

sentences.en: Sailors came out with hooks and ropes.
sentences.tgt: Des:o marins:n sortirent:v avec:o des:o crochets:n et:o des:o cordes:n .:o

sentences.en: The sailors put the hooks in the great ring and pulled the box to the ship.
sentences.tgt: Les:o marins:n mirent:v les:o crochets:n dans:o le:o grand:a anneau:n et:o tirèrent:v la:o boîte:n vers:o le:o navire:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver called from the box, and the sailors answered him.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o appela:v depuis:o la:o boîte:n ,:o et:o les:o marins:n lui:o répondirent:v .:o

sentences.en: The sailors cut a hole in the roof of the box.
sentences.tgt: Les:o marins:n découpèrent:v un:o trou:n dans:o le:o toit:n de:o la:o boîte:n .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver came out of the box into the wind of the sea.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o sortit:v de:o la:o boîte:n dans:o le:o vent:n de:o la:o mer:n .:o

sentences.en: The captain gave him hot food and hot drink.
sentences.tgt: Le:o capitaine:n lui:o donna:v de:o la:o nourriture:n chaude:a et:o une:o boisson:n chaude:a .:o

sentences.en: Gulliver told the captain of the land of the giants.
sentences.tgt: Gulliver:o raconta:v au:o capitaine:n l':o histoire:n du:o pays:n des:o géants:n .:o

sentences.en: The captain laughed, as the other captain had laughed at the little cows.
sentences.tgt: Le:o capitaine:n rit:v ,:o comme:o l':o autre:o capitaine:n avait:v ri:v des:o petites:a vaches:n .:o

sentences.en: But the sailors looked at the box, at the ring, and at the strange wood.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o les:o marins:n regardèrent:v la:o boîte:n ,:o la:o bague:n ,:o et:o le:o bois:n étrange:a .:o

sentences.en: "No man of England made this box," said the captain.
sentences.tgt: «:o Aucun:o homme:n d':o Angleterre:o n':o a:v fabriqué:v cette:o boîte:n ,:o »:o dit:v -il:o le:o capitaine:n .:o

sentences.en: The ship sailed for England, week after week.
sentences.tgt: Le:o navire:n navigua:v vers:o l':o Angleterre:o ,:o semaine:n après:o semaine:n .:o

sentences.en: At home in England, Gulliver's wife laughed and cried again to see him.
sentences.tgt: Chez:o lui:o en:o Angleterre:o ,:o la:o femme:n de:o Gulliver:o rit:v et:o pleura:v de:o nouveau:a en:o le:o voyant:v .:o

sentences.en: But the people of England looked strange and small to Gulliver.
sentences.tgt: Mais:o les:o gens:n d':o Angleterre:o semblaient:v étranges:a et:o petits:a à:o Gulliver:o .:o

sentences.en: He walked with great care in the town, for the men looked small as children.

sentences.en: At night, by the fire, he told his children of little Lilliput and the giants of Brobdingnag.
